items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() method or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后但初始化回调（如InitializingBean'sInitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()方法或自定义 init-method）之前调用。

items.source: For a list of all bean lifecycle methods, see the BeanFactory javadocs.
items.translation: 有关所有 Bean 生命周期方法的列表，请参阅 BeanFactory javadocs。

items.source:
This is mainly intended to be implemented by framework classes which
have to pick up application classes by name despite themselves potentially
being loaded from a shared class loader.
items.translation: 这主要旨在由框架类实现，这些框架类必须通过名称加载应用程序类，即使它们自身可能来自共享的类加载器。

items.source: Callback that supplies the bean class loader to a bean instance.
items.translation: 向 Bean 实例提供 类加载器 的回调。
